contactPage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about working with ProGanda.
contactPage.faq1Q: How fast can we launch a campaign after the initial consultation?
contactPage.faq1A: Fast-track campaigns can be scripted, matched with creators, and ready to shoot within 5 to 7 business days. Full studio productions typically take 2 weeks.
contactPage.faq2Q: What is included in the complimentary consultation session?
contactPage.faq2A: A 30-minute 1-on-1 video call with a creative lead. We review your current social performance, campaign goals, target audience, and provide a tailored creator shortlist.
contactPage.faq3Q: Do you handle creator contracting, usage rights, and payments?
contactPage.faq3A: Yes, end-to-end. We manage talent agreements, commercial usage licensing, deliverables quality control, and streamlined payouts.
contactPage.faq4Q: Can creators and bloggers book studio time directly?
contactPage.faq4A: Yes. Roster members and Creator Pro subscribers get dedicated studio access, audio/video equipment, and in-house editing support.
